label: Community (incl. microbiome)
text: BI.O.A5.3 Community. Who co-occurs, and the structure of the interaction web. Diversity is a count or a named index; say which. Niche is the set of conditions and resources under which a population persists, fundamental versus realised. The host-associated microbiome is a community claim here, citing BI.O.A3 for host function.

warrant.standard: Replicated field or mesocosm experiment; time series with stated uncertainty
warrant.defeaters: Pseudoreplication; scale mismatch; confounded gradients; detection bias
